Cash and stock: per share, $4.10 in cash plus 0.1557 shares of Parent Common Stock (Merger Exchange Ratio), with cash in lieu of fractional shares and any unpaid pre-closing dividends; no CVRs are referenced.
Merger consideration components include: (1) Per Share Cash Consideration of $4.10 per Company Common Stock; (2) Per Share Stock Consideration of 0.1557 shares of Parent Common Stock per Company share (Merger Exchange Ratio); (3) cash in lieu of fractional shares (Fractional Share Consideration); (4) conversions of Company Equity Awards into Converted Parent Options, Parent RSU Awards, and Parent PRSU Awards (based on the Merger Consideration Closing Value and the Parent Measurement Price); (5) post-closing Dividends or Distributions on Parent Common Stock; (6) treatment for Non-Employee Holders (Non-Employee Holder Consideration); and (7) Dissenting Shares are not part of the Merger Consideration (appraisal rights apply under DGCL 262). No CVRs are defined in the provided text.
0.1557; per-share Merger Consideration comprises $4.10 in cash and 0.1557 fully paid and non-assessable shares of Parent Common Stock (in book-entry form) per Company share.
